title: pasania thomsonii
intro: Pasania thomsonii, commonly known as Himalayan Sandalwood, is a plant species of the family Meliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pasania thomsonii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pasania thomsonii include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
